operative_clauses: Sec. 112. EFFECTIVE DATE. Unless otherwise specifically provided, this article is effective the day following final enactment for purposes of limits on net debt, the issuance of bonds, certificates of indebtedness, and capital notes and is effective beginning for taxes payable in 2014 for all other purposes.
signed_quote: Signed by the governor May 23, 2013, 12:13 p.m.
